name: ANSI/IEEE Loudspeaker annunciation form
summary: IEEE-library form of loudspeaker annunciation: a loudspeaker indication identifies conversion of an electrical signal to an audible output.
description: This reference locates loudspeaker annunciation in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented annunciations family. A loudspeaker indication identifies conversion of an electrical signal to an audible output. The public library uses HAN1B7 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.
